display.purpose: The month in words and the people-book title. Month and match pages step to 1.75rem below 768px; the home desk keeps the token size.

title.purpose: A section heading, sitting on a ruling underline.

body.purpose: Sentences and secondary buttons. Prose stays within a 72-character measure.

label.purpose: The history, payee, or account name on a row, and the visible label of a field.

button.purpose: Primary actions and the month-page stamp. Secondary buttons stay at body weight.

meta.purpose: Filenames, coordinates, the month-folder slug, document kind, in soft ink. Compact stamp uses this size at weight 600.

amount.purpose: Right-aligned money, tabular figures. Dates on a row use the same tabular figures at body weight.

chave.purpose: The 44-digit access key only, in IBM Plex Mono, shown as eleven groups of four.

shadows.name: lote-tick-reading
shadows.purpose: Hollow tick while a document is being read. A drawn outline, not elevation.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Navigation wraps under the product name below this width.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Wide gutter, two-pane home desk, ruled ledger sheets, two-column insert, and display type on month/match pages.

breakpoints.name: match
breakpoints.purpose: Match screen splits payments and documents into two columns.

narrative.overview:
The interface is a well-kept Brazilian cash book. The page is cool ledger paper. Every list of money is a ruled row: date, history, amount, status, with figures in tabular numbers and the amount on the right. The only loud hue is the red of the cash-book margin. It marks a payment that still lacks a document, an error, a failed invite, and a destructive action. A month page with no red in the records is ready to close.

Density follows the coordinator's laptop ritual. Início is a two-pane close desk: a 26rem month index on the left, the selected month or the people book on the right. Every other signed-in page is one left-aligned column, 72rem at most, sections separated by a rule. Status stays on the row. The form that changes a row folds into a disclosure or a work panel the person opens. The submitter's phone uses the same tokens, stacked.

The closed month is an ink stamp, the only double-ruled mark in the system. The app mark repeats the same three strokes — a green field, two paper rules, one red margin — and carries no wordmark. The header always reads the product name. When more than one organization is in play, a caixa-filled switcher opens a sheet list under it.
keyCharacteristics: **Ruled rows.** Money and document lists are a ledger sheet: vertical and horizontal rules, not cards.
**Two layouts.** Início and Configuração are two-pane desks. Close work, documents, and administration stay a single ledger column.
**One red.** `margem` is the only red. It is a left rule on a blocked row, a sentence, a quiet destructive word, or a toast fill.
**Flat paper.** Depth is a hairline rule, not a drop shadow. A work panel is a ruling-bordered sheet.
**The stamp.** A closed month is inked and double-ruled. The index uses a compact “Fechado”; the month page uses “Mês fechado”.
**One type family.** IBM Plex Sans for the book; IBM Plex Mono only for the access key.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: `margem` is the only red. A month page with no red in the records is ready to close.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, and headings stay in sentence case. No all-caps, no eyebrow, no letterspaced small caps. The header product name is the one title-case exception: `Fechamento Mensal`.

rules.name: The Chave Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only on the access key.

rules.name: The Ledger Column Rule
rules.body: Money and document records are a ruled sheet with aligned columns, vertical rules, and tabular figures. The amount is right-aligned. Status and each action occupy their own columns. The home month index and the people book are single-rule lists, not sheets.

rules.name: The Shared Track Rule
rules.body: Head and body of a sheet use the same column template. Action tracks are fixed rem, never `auto` or `max-content`: the header cell is empty, and a content-sized track would let the row drift off the rule.

rules.name: The Desk Rule
rules.body: Início and Configuração are two panes from 768px. Do not restack those pages as chapters.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. Depth is the ruling line and the red margin. Do not introduce a drop shadow to float a panel.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: The only double-ruled mark is the closed-month stamp. Its double rule is the whole treatment.

rules.name: The Four Pixel Rule
rules.body: Controls, fields, and panels share one small corner. The page itself stays square.

dos: **Do** set a missing-document row and an error notice with a 3px left border in `margem` and 12px of inset.
**Do** fill a primary action with `caixa`, a sheet-white label, weight 600, and 8px by 16px padding.
**Do** separate sections with a ruling line under the heading, and draw each money or document list as one flat ruled sheet with vertical rules between cells.
**Do** keep payment rows denser than other lists, with Status and Documento as separate columns on the month payment sheet.
**Do** give the header row and every data row of a sheet the same column template; size action tracks in rem, not auto.
**Do** self-host IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono. The page makes no third-party font request.
**Do** draw focus as a 2px solid `caixa` ring, offset 2px, on every control.
**Do** keep Início as a two-pane desk for the coordinator; keep the 72rem column for every other close-work page.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second red, a drop shadow, a gradient, or a decorative icon set. Sort and row-action strokes, and “+” / “−” zoom, are the allowed exceptions; the mark stays the only brand emblem.
**Don't** put a money record in a card. Column alignment is how the book is scanned.
**Don't** set a heading in all caps, small caps, or a serif display.
**Don't** tint the page warm cream. The paper is the cool ledger gray-green.
**Don't** disable the close action to hide a reason. The reason is a `margem` sentence.
**Don't** add CSS transitions or keyframes. Wait and toast appear because the person submitted; they do not ease in.
